description: This file contains build configuration and scripting for Linux kernel compilation within the OpenWrt build system, including kernel preparation, initramfs setup, and image copying.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the Linux kernel source, either by extracting from a tarball or linking to an external kernel tree.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs/PreConfigure
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration for initramfs, setting kernel config options based on build options.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Sets up the kernel configuration for initramfs, including compression and root filesystem options.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes initramfs configuration from the kernel config.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the kernel build, copying configuration files and setting kernel options.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Initramfs
methods.description: Configures the kernel for initramfs using the specified parameters.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules/Default
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules and saves the configuration state.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies the compiled kernel image and related files to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and copies it to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/PrepareConfigPerRootfs
methods.description: Prepares a kernel configuration directory for a specific root filesystem.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Initramfs
methods.description: Builds an initramfs image for the kernel, if configured.
